title: What's New: Upgrade to Preview (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Admin Center Demo - Selecting Preview Version

features.name: Copy Production Data to Sandbox and Upgrade to Preview
features.description: Allows customers to take a copy of production data into a sandbox environment and upgrade that sandbox to a preview version of the next Business Central release.
caveats: Functionality might be changing during preview period
Will be cleaned up after preview ends with normal grace period

features.name: Preview Version Selection in Admin Center
features.description: Users can select preview version 27.0 from admin center by modifying target versions and selecting the available preview version.

features.name: Scheduled Update Dates
features.description: Users can select and schedule the date for when the update to preview version should run.

features.name: Preview Terms and Learn More Links
features.description: Admin center displays links to learn more page and preview terms under the target version selection.

features.name: Automatic Rescheduling of Failed Updates
features.description: During the preview period, failed updates are automatically rescheduled every seven days.

features.name: Automatic Update to Official Version After Preview
features.description: Once the preview period ends, environments are automatically scheduled to update to the next official version and preview version is no longer visible in admin center.
